_anglais: Mom, if I had a job, I’d marry my wife because...
All this? It’s coming out of *you*.
Yeah, it’s coming out of you. The words, the hands—all you.
Yeah, it’s my *language*, mom. Oh my God.
In this alley, this plot you found better to have a wife—and that wife? It’s your daughter.
Mom says ‘my daughter,’ but you can’t even take the day shift, you can’t *get* it—someone tell me, ‘my daughter’?
Sorry, mom, I love your daughter a lot, and one day when I’ve got my *job*...
I told you, mom—she fell back, but she’s still your future mother-in-law. You can’t even *try*, I don’t know—okay, fine, I’ll handle it.
We already dropped you into a house like it was a parachute.
Well, my dad wasn’t *parachuted* in. And my mom? You’re the one marrying my daughter.
Do you want for a glass of water? Bring me a glass too.
A glass of water for me too.
